title: PROJECTOR
rule: one frame, eight pieces of work: the frame never moves, the log scrolls beside it and decides what the frame shows
description: Eight pieces of work as a log of eight rows, beside one fixed frame. It opens on a live product (Bayyinah TV pricing page) and then the strongest result (one billing report: 16 requests to the database and a timeout, now 2). The row at the reading line is the current one; the frame shows its screen, and a hairline runs from the row's result into the frame to the part that proves it.
signature: Big Shoulders Display for the row numerals, the report diagram and the slide tray; Public Sans for text; ink #141B06 on a chartreuse field #D9F26B (14.2:1; muted #3E4A14 at 7.7:1). Desktop: a 440 px log at the left with the identity line at its top; an 880 x 676 frame at the right, sticky, with a caption and an eight-slot tray under it, set in the middle of the viewport. Row order: 01 Bayyinah TV (pricing page, ring on the Monthly/Annual switch, result 'Members pay monthly or yearly', plus a 'Live at bayyinahtv.com' link); 02 care platform server side as a diagram (16 outlined cells and 'Gave up' over 2 filled cells and 'Finished', ring on the Now lane); 03 care card recreation (ring on the organization switch); 04 Viva Fresh and 08 Dukagjini Bookstore as iPhone screens at their source pixels (596 x 676 and 568 x 676, flush right) with an App Store / Google Play panel at the left of the frame; 05 Design System v2 specimen with the three token rows spread evenly; 06 Incentiv sign-in; 07 reader recreation. Motion: at load the text appears once its fonts are in (capped at 1.2 s, so no line moves), the first screenshot fades in 200 ms, then the hairline draws in 180 ms to its ring. A row becomes current after it settles at 42% of the viewport for 160 ms; the plate cross-fades in 200 ms, the numeral fills (160 ms), the result band wipes in (clip-path, 240 ms), the old line fades (120 ms) and the new one draws (180 ms). Keyboard moves (arrows, Home, End, tray Left/Right) jump with no animation. Phone: the frame pins at the top at 4:3 (max 568 px wide); each screenshot crop grows to the frame width inside its own screen bounds, so it is never shown above its source pixels; the ring alone marks the proof (no line in the 16 px gutter); at the page end the last row is current and stands whole under the frame. Reduced motion: no fade, no wipe, no draw; the line and ring appear at once.
holdback: Lowest: original, 7/10. A sticky frame beside a scrolling numbered log is a known scrollytelling layout; the report diagram and the store panel are new, the frame is not. Other limits after round 8: the two store screens are shown at source pixels, but the store images hold a 596 / 568 px wide phone screen, so the frame's left 284 / 312 px hold the store links, not screen; harmony stays 8 until a reviewer accepts that panel. The Viva Fresh desktop crop ends inside the first two product cards (images only, no text cut). The Viva Fresh ring proves 'live in both app stores' (the two store links); 'Shopping in Albanian' is read from the screen beside it. Row 01's ring proves 'monthly or yearly'; 'live' is carried by its link. The specimen (row 05) still prints token names (cobalt.600, action.primary); it is a recreation and no longer on the first screen. The Incentiv page keeps about 130 px of its own dark ground above and below its sign-in card. The reader page stands in its own ground with about 100 px at each side. Phone: a grown crop can end inside a UI row on some widths; text in every crop stays at 11 px or more at 375 px.
